newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus to auction 91-day t-bills worth 35 mln.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus to auction 91-day t-bills worth 35 mln.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus will auction up to 35 million pounds ($66.7 million) worth of 91-day treasury bills with a July 23 issue date, the bank said on Tuesday.
Competitive or non-competitive bids for the issue can be made from July 21 to July 23 at 09.00 local (0600 GMT).

In competitive bidding, bidders set the price they are willing to pay to buy the bills. The bid can be accepted in part or in whole only if the price set is equal or higher than the price set by the central bank for the specific issue. The minimum bid is set at 10,000 pounds.
Non-competitive bids are those in which the bidder will pay the average price of competitive bids accepted by the central bank. The minimum bid is 1,000 pounds. ($=0.52 pound)
